feature_contract.goal: Remove quadratic CPU valid-range merge and repeated linear VB/IB shadow coverage scans from the shipped R26+HUD stereo path while preserving exact partial-lock correctness, scene draw semantics, and safe fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R26+HUD GPU shadow valid-byte range maintenance and its portable Windows host smoke only; no lens/GOAL/+TIME, game timer, effects, shaders, FFB, DX11 or DXVK changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Source-confirmed shipped R26+HUD merge repeatedly vector::erase inside a loop and linearly scans disjoint ranges. Split R30 already has a logarithmic search and contiguous erase; a deterministic 16384-disjoint-range workload exercises the asymptotic gap.
trace_stages: D3D9 dynamic vertex/index buffer partial Lock/Unlock submits per-buffer writes to R26+HUD CPU shadow.
R26+HUD merges byte intervals into a sorted coalesced vector; old loop rescans/shifts for every update.
Per-eye VB/IB transformed draws test the shadow coverage and must fall back if an interval is missing.
Final packaged R26+HUD Windows game and full-chain host compile/validation preserve correct routing.
subcomponents: Replace shipped R26+HUD VB/IB valid interval write maintenance with bounded sorted/coalesced lower-bound merge and contiguous erase.
Replace shipped stereo shadow coverage read with constant-time tail and binary search while retaining absence fallback.
Exercise deterministic source-shared portable random differential, out-of-order bridge, DISCARD/reset, and 16k disjoint-stream regression.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Shipped stereo VB/IB CPU shadow range maintenance
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Ascending partial updates append in constant amortized vector time; overlapping out-of-order writes coalesce without repeated erase.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Partial-lock validity and original draw fallback
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Gaps are never read as valid and empty/discarded buffers do not inherit old CPU shadow coverage, including out-of-order bridging.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Win32 DX9Ex game, x64 host and source-isolation gates
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Portable regression and exact-SHA Active game/host/package, Domain and full-source impacted gates pass at one validation-bearing SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The R26+HUD package compile owner in CMake is stereo_renderer_r30_r26_safe.cpp; it still has erase-in-loop merge and per-draw linear scans after the split R30 owner was optimized.
diagnosis.root_cause: Shipped R26+HUD valid-byte-interval maintenance scans and individually erases every intersecting vector range; both update and stereo draw-time coverage query can become linear per operation.
source_trace: Game D3D9 partial Lock/Unlock sends a byte write span into the R26+HUD VB or IB shadow.
R30MergeValidRange updates the sorted validity vector; previous erases repeatedly shift its tail.
R30RangeValid gates CPU shadow reads that feed the two stereo eye vertex/index reconstructions.
Release/Discard/recovery invalidate shadow data and original game Draw remains the fail-closed fallback.
alternatives_rejected: Do not change GPU draw admission, per-eye matrices, effects or shader state; isolated interval bookkeeping already differs across packaged and full-chain owners.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Both shipped R26+HUD interval write and read now delegate to one portable C++ helper with tail fast-path, binary search and one coalesced erase.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Portable smoke asserts invalid gaps, empty/inverted updates, out-of-order joins, all prior ranges invalid after clear, and deterministic 4000-update differential model.

runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR testing; portable/CI results cannot prove user-observed frame pacing or FPS.
